description: Change of use of existing public house (Use Class Sui Generis) into a new Hatzola Ambulance station and medical training centre / office facility (Use Class Sui Generis), with associated extensions/internal reconfigurations, and removal of resident street parking for new ambulance bay crossover and emergency vehicle parking.
decision_conditions: <p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to the commencement of the relevant works of the development or stage in the development, as may be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, a scheme including the following components to address the risks associated with site contamination shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;</span></p><p><b style="font-weight:normal;" id="docs-internal-guid-a5504aca-7fff-c988-62c9-99f719193312"><br></b></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-left: 36pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">a) A preliminary risk assessment which identifies all previous uses, potential contaminants associated with those uses (including asbestos, landfill gas, vapours and ground water contaminants); a conceptual model of the site indicating sources, pathways and receptors; and potentially unacceptable risks arising from contamination at the site;&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-left: 36pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">b) A generic and detailed quantitative risk assessment based on (a) that identifies the risk to all receptors potentially affected, including those off site;&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-left: 36pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">c) In the event that remediation measures are deemed necessary following the results of (b), an options appraisal identifying feasible remediation options, detailing evaluation of options, and selecting the most appropriate remediation option(s);&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-left: 36pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">d) A remediation strategy focused on the remediation option(s) selected in (c) setting site specific monitoring objectives and criteria, providing details of monitoring and maintenance, and containing full details of the remediation measures required, and how they are to be undertaken.&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-left: 36pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">e) A verification plan explaining how the effectiveness of the remediation works set out in (d) will be measured, and how data will be collected and assessed to demonstrate that the remediation objectives and criteria will be met.&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-left: 36pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">f) A verification report demonstrating that remediation objectives and criteria identified in (e) have been met, assessing the remediation performance, and creating a final record of the land quality whilst providing a plan for long term monitoring and maintenance (if required).&nbsp;</span></p><p><b style="font-weight:normal;"><br></b></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Any investigation and risk assessment must be undertaken in strict accordance with the requirements of the Environment Agency’s Land Contamination Risk Management (LCRM). If additional significant contamination is found at any time when carrying out the approved development, it must immediately be reported in writing to the Local Planning Authority. For the avoidance of doubt, this condition can be discharged on a section by section basis.&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To protect human health and the environment by ensuring no harm is caused by land contamination, in line with paragraphs H, I and J, LP 58 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and the Hackney contaminated land strategy 2022 - 2030.</span></p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved a minimum of two swift nesting bricks and/or boxes and one bat box shall be provided at or close to eaves level of the development hereby approved. The bricks/boxes shall be retained thereafter in perpetuity. <br><br>REASON: in the interests of biodiversity.</p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Unless otherwise hereby approved, all new works in respect of all the works hereby approved and any other incidental works to be carried out in this connection shall match the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-840f0d21-7fff-f3bc-630e-1bda4c1ed26b"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and safeguard the interest of the locally listed building.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, a detailed Operational Management Plan (OMP) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The OMP shall detail the management procedures intended to safeguard pedestrian safety and the amenity of the area shall detail the specific procedures for Banksman control and the use of reversing cameras and alarms for ambulances. The development shall thereafter be carried out in strict accordance with the approved plan.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-8ca55fe3-7fff-b2ae-b08c-35ea988dfdd0"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: In the interests of highway safety and to safeguard the amenity of the surrounding area.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, a detailed Delivery and Servicing Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The plan shall identify and detail the management of all servicing requirements for the development, including, but not limited to:</span></p><ol><li style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 12pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Vehicle Access and Routing - Designated routing for delivery and servicing vehicles (including typical vehicle size) to and from the site, ensuring minimum conflict with surrounding traffic and sensitive residential areas.</span></li><li style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 12pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Delivery Times - Specific and restricted times for all commercial deliveries, services (including refuse collection), and waste removal to minimise noise and disturbance to neighbouring properties.</span></li><li style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 12pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">On-Site Management - Details of the designated loading/unloading bay areas and refuse storage areas, demonstrating that all servicing can be safely accommodated entirely within the site boundaries without obstructing the public highway.</span></li><li style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 12pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Staffing and Enforcement - A strategy detailing how the plan will be monitored and enforced by the site manager or managing agent.</span></li></ol><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The development shall be operated entirely in accordance with the approved plan at all times thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-3386198f-7fff-2292-ba7e-f5fa554d0dba"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure that adequate provision is made for deliveries and servicing which do not lead to unacceptable impacts on highway safety and safeguard the amenity of the area.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">No demolition or development shall take place until a Stage 1 written scheme of investigation (WSI) has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing. For land that is included within the WSI, no demolition or development shall take place other than in accordance with the agreed WSI, and the programme and methodology of site evaluation and the nomination of a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed works.&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">If heritage assets of archaeological interest are identified by Stage 1 then for those parts of the site which have archaeological interest, a stage 2 WSI shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing. For land that is included within the Stage 2 WSI, no demolition/development shall take place other than in accordance with the agreed Stage 2 WSI which shall include:</span></p><ol style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0;padding-inline-start:48px;"><li dir="ltr" style="list-style-type:upper-alpha;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;" aria-level="1"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;" role="presentation"><span statement of significance and research objectives, the programme and methodology of site investigation and recording and the nomination of a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed works</span></p></li><li dir="ltr" style="list-style-type:upper-alpha;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;" appropriate, details of programme for delivering related positive public benefits</span></p></li><li dir="ltr" style="list-style-type:upper-alpha;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;" aria-level="1"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;" role="presentation"><span programme for post-investigation assessment and subsequent analysis, publication and dissemination and deposition of resulting material. This part of the condition shall not be discharged until these elements have been fulfilled in accordance with the programme set out in the Stage 2 WSI.</span></p></li></ol><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-d36f130d-7fff-d84c-9283-7eb5a8bcc3a5"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: This pre-commencement condition is necessary to safeguard the archaeological interest on this site. Approval of the WSI before works begin on site provides clarity on what investigations are required, and their timing in relation to the development programme.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Within three months of the date of first occupation of the development, a final BREEAM Certificate confirming the scheme has achieved “Excellent” shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-18f313ec-7fff-2819-3fb1-642907ff79fd"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To ensure that the sustainability credentials of the proposed development are acceptable in order to help address climate change and in accordance with adopted policies.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">No development involving alterations to the public highway shall commence until a Stage 1 and Stage 2 Road Safety Audit (RSA) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The development shall not be first occupied until a Stage 3 Pre-Opening RSA has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. All recommendations agreed upon by the Local Planning Authority shall be implemented prior to the opening of the works to the public highway.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-09a09a92-7fff-7a1c-b308-fb28b9646b08"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: In the interests of highway safety.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-64ec520f-7fff-7eb4-407a-326bf258d920"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-fca3f085-7fff-c0e5-080a-e4f3cadd030c"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.</span></p>

<p>A Construction Logistics Plan (CLP) specifying hours of working, construction traffic routing, measures to prevent dust pollution and contact arrangements between residents and contractors shall be submitted and agreed by the Local Planning Authority Prior to the commencement of the development. The construction logistics plan shall include the following details:&nbsp;<br>(a) loading and unloading of plant and materials;&nbsp;<br>(b) storage of plant and materials;&nbsp;<br>(c) programme of works (including measures for traffic management);&nbsp;<br>(d) provision of boundary hoarding behind any visibility zones;&nbsp;<br>(e) wheel cleaning provision on site. Construction shall thereafter take place in accordance with the measures identified within the approved Construction Logistics Plan (CLP).&nbsp;<br><br>REASON: To ensure that during demolition and construction works that there would be no negative amenity or highway impacts as a result of the development. These details are required prior to commencement as they affect the entirety of the construction phase and cannot, therefore, be dealt with retrospectively.</p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, a detailed Parking Design and Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The plan should clearly detail the final location, layout, size, and marking of all disabled and Doctor’s parking spaces, including the specific allocation of accessible/Blue Badge bays. The development shall be carried out entirely in accordance with the approved Parking Design and Management Plan, and these areas shall be retained and maintained thereafter for the duration of the development's use.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-5241975a-7fff-7f3e-a336-1f7a624b70d0"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To promote sustainable modes of transport in accordance with policy T6 of the London Plan (2021) and policy LP45 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</span></p>

<p>Notwithstanding the details submitted, no development of the green roof areas shall commence until a detailed Biosolar Roof Implementation and Management Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The plan shall include, but not be limited to:</p><p>a) A detailed planting specification for the biosolar areas, including evidence that low-growing vegetation (e.g., sedum) will be utilised adjacent to Photovoltaic (PV) panels to prevent shading and minimise fire risk.</p><p>b) Plans showing the location, width, and specification of all proposed fire breaks within the green roof system.</p><p>c) A statement confirming the biosolar roof system meets all relevant fire safety regulations in force at the time of construction.</p><p>d) A schedule detailing the proposed implementation, establishment, and initial management regime for the biosolar roof.</p><p>The approved plan shall be implemented in full, and maintained thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p><div><span id="docs-internal-guid-8b4582d1-7fff-068a-5867-f0806ac30387"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure the viability, long-term effectiveness, and fire safety of the proposed biosolar roof system, and to accord with policy LP47 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and the Environment Act 2021 BNG Requirements.</span></span></div>
